observation: Critique loop (Phase 2 design+architecture independent review) found 2 CRITICAL architecture gaps (C1 page-classification precedence ambiguity, C2 no-cycle gate unenforceable) BEFORE write-tests. Designer revised plan same session. Builder received clean spec, TDD tests matched intent precisely. Code review found zero 'spec mismatch' class failures (only tool/toolchain issues like flat-config precedence). Zero exploratory red→green rework. Contrast: without critique, gaps discovered at Phase 4 or Phase 5 = rework. Protect the critique loop + revision cycle.

CRITICAL-1 (AC8 no-cycle ESLint rule did not fire on viewer/discovery.ts): ESLint flat-config gotcha — ignores:[] beats files:[] within same config object, no override. Builder wrongly asserted opposite in inline comment ('files override ignores'). Split single block into 2 blocks (AC8a for src/**, AC8b for discovery.ts) so each scope unambiguous. Lore: eslint.config.ts lines 712-761 + @lore block documents precedence. Mitigation: document in code, split conflicting scopes, test boundary files (file in ignores dir where rule should fire).

CRITICAL-2 (AC9 snapshot churn guard violated): design-only fixture story (CatalogAxis.stories.tsx) committed to src/ (glob scope), rendered as real catalog component. Snapshot caught additive drift (157 lines). Root: design comment 'may be deleted once real wiring ships' — builder didn't read/prioritize. Embodiment-story lifecycle: design-phase fixture → optionally-commit-with-deletion-trigger → delete-before-glob-render. Pattern: design-only stories (CatalogAxis in AJ6, token-gallery in W2, overlay-mockups in AJ5) leaking into snapshots. Mitigation: plan names fixture story + deletion trigger explicitly; code review verifies deletion or confirms intentional-keep (dev-demo page).

Bonus finding (W-1): seg() path-matching false-positives. Prefix-substring matching allowed 'pages/work-summary.stories.tsx' to match seg('pages/work') even though file not in pages/work/ dir. Tightened to require trailing '/' segment boundary. Added 3 tests proving false-prefix rejects + true-segment accepts. False-prefix path matching is a subtle class of bug in classification logic; requires explicit boundary-marker discipline + test coverage.

Artifact shadow: stale discovery.js (gitignored build artifact from prior tsconfig) sitting in viewer/__tests__/ was discoverable by vitest before TS source. Tests passed but smell of stale state. Mitigation: extend .gitignore to catch build outputs (**/src/**/*.{js,js.map,d.ts,d.ts.map,tsbuildinfo}); before major test runs, check for stray .js/.d.ts in source dirs; vitest discovery will fail if shadow breaks test (UX friction, not silent correctness issue).

Cost breakdown: productive work ~8.5h (Phase 2 critique 2h + designer revision 0.5h + Phase 3 build 4h + Phase 4 code review 1.5h + Phase 5 ship 0.5h); infrastructure overhead 0h (no stale-base rebases, no attestation churn, no CI rerun loops, no permission prompts). Session fast. Why? Concept+architecture locked in prior session eliminated spec drift; critique pinned ambiguities before write-tests; designer revision loop propagated findings into clean plan for builder; TDD green-first-pass (zero exploratory rework). Zero infrastructure friction = high signal of pipeline health.
